summary: Decode bounded local Outlook MSG containers with the pinned MIT-licensed python-oxmsg package, then reuse the existing safe EML evidence, workflow and selected-attachment paths.
decision_refs: Active user goal to improve adaptability for RFI, Submittal and Email content
Explicit user request under /ponytail to prefer existing open-source code over custom implementation
Offline validation against public python-oxmsg fixtures at commit d0ee4645d4a8bf6d18517d33bc1f7dcb23e7620b
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested continued optimization with /ponytail and preference for open-source reuse.
known_limitations: MSG files above the existing 8 MB local email parsing limit fail before model work.
Mailbox synchronization, automatic attachment recursion and semantic thread inference remain unsupported.
Attachments stored only by reference remain visible as non-importable metadata when the upstream parser provides no bytes.
Public upstream fixtures validate format integration, not construction-domain extraction accuracy on customer mail.
